# raw-2-single

The same Sable Mutual pack as `tests/fixtures/rehearsal/raw-2`, pasted into one Markdown file. `cases.json` and `cases-surface.json` are copies of that pack. `openapi.json` is the kit file. The ledgers are unchanged. None are debatable.

The 9 October email still wins. Run the two case files separately. Do not pass `--style`.

## Precedence

1. The meeting of 1 October 2026, 10:00, is the base: opening, identity, product order, the 9th and 6th business days, the account-field floor, notes, and the text-message sentence.
2. The Slack messages of 6 October add Monday 19 October 2026 as a holiday, and they try to set a 3rd-business-day late deadline and a 40 percent floor.
3. The email of 9 October quotes those two Slack sentences and withdraws them. Where it conflicts with Slack or the meeting, the email wins. The Slack holiday still stands.
4. The code list maps `arranged` to the kit outcome `promise`. The ledgers use `promise`.

## Where each live rule is

| Rule | Where it lives |
|---|---|
| Opening, identity, product order, notes, attempt shape | 1 October meeting. The email says the rest of that meeting still applies |
| Holiday Monday 19 October 2026 | Slack, Dana, 2026-10-06T09:14:00, and the email says that part still stands |
| Late deadline, the 2nd business day, Friday 16 October 2026 | 9 October email. Slack's 3rd and the meeting's 6th are dead |
| Early deadline, the 4th business day, Wednesday 21 October 2026 | 9 October email. The meeting's 9th is dead |
| Floor, 30 percent. 2125.10 → 637.53. 1320 → 396.00 | 9 October email. Slack's 40 percent is the quoted text and is withdrawn |
| Confirmation sentence | 9 October email. The meeting's text-message sentence is replaced |
| Worked business days and the Tuesday after the holiday | 9 October email |
| Outcome `arranged` | 1 October meeting, then the code list sends `promise` |

The quoted Slack lines inside the email are not the rule. PUB-11 is 220, 640 and 75 on 2026-10-20. PUB-12 is 510 on 2026-10-15 and 396 on 2026-10-16, with the car refused. PUB-13 is 300 on 2026-10-21 and 900 on 2026-10-16. PUB-04 is 1250 on 2026-10-16. PUB-06 is 637.53 on 2026-10-16. PUB-07 is 540 on 2026-10-21.
